deviations_from_card: Case 5 dropped per the revision, so there are 6 cases, not 7. In commit 1, derived counts are the default and they override the counts pages still hand in (the card's rollback text says hand counts 'still win' in commit 1). I kept the default the card states (derived), so commit 1 alone already shows correct counts; nothing renders differently except the numbers. Incidents keeps exactly today's given counts; in its paged (cut) path it still shows no counts, as it does today. simulator/Runs hoists its now-static facet spec to a module const, which removed the useMemo and an unused rows binding. facetCounts runs one text pass, then one predicate per row per option. Inside FilterTable I paid for the new bytes with behaviour-preserving dedupes: a spacer() helper, an int() formatter, hoisting q = deferred.trim(), and a faceted flag. Those were needed because onair.l2 had only 135 B of headroom at the base.
